info.title: WearWise Backend API
info.description: WearWise AI Fashion & Honest Fit Platform API — Phase 6A Vertical Slice

post.description:
Creates a new body profile anchor for the authenticated user,
initializing revision 1, canonical stature, and shape controls.

get.description: Retrieves profile summary and active measurements for authenticated owner.

post.description:
Appends a new revision with recorded measurements.
Enforces optimistic locking on expected_revision.

get.description: Retrieves active measurements for the profile.
Retrieves timeline of measurements across revisions.
Returns supported semantic controls catalog and safe bounds.

put.description: Updates semantic body controls by creating a new revision.

post.description:
Generates a 3D avatar mesh from profile revision using NAVER Anny adapter,
saves the GLB into content-addressable storage, extracts anthropometry,
and updates active measurements.

get.description: Retrieves avatar asset generation status and mesh validation metrics.

Streams private binary glTF 2.0 payload.
Ownership is evaluated before checking conditional caching headers.

post.description: Creates a new garment profile and initial revision for the authenticated brand.
Adds or updates a size specification on the active garment revision.

get.description: Retrieves garment specification and complete size table.
Retrieves specification revisions for a garment.

post.description:
Evaluates active profile measurements against garment size dimensions
using the approved Phase 5A Honest Fit Engine and persists recommendation.

get.description: Retrieves persisted fit recommendation result after verifying ownership.
